note: Plan E (melee deny by evidence): the melee door's deny slice, read beside core_slice_melee.json by the shadow and probes while the allow file stays the live default (until step 20 flips it). A unit carrying a listed primitive or attachment stays on the table; every other rule the registry automates goes to the core. Unknown or unautomated rules stay refused unless inert or unmapped_inert; the list only shrinks after the gate.
unmapped_inert_why: A rule name no rules map knows for the unit's system and faction (an upgrade's own label such as Wandering Mystic, War Paint, Combat Shield): the registry gives neither side anything to read, and the rules the upgrade grants are carried and checked on their own.

inert.Unique: A list-building restriction only (army book); no effect on a melee.
inert.Army Standard Bearer: An upgrade's own label; the rules it grants (Fear(2)) are carried and checked on their own in melee.
inert.Courage: The bare base the Courage Aura expansion stamps; no map entry on either side - the +1 morale in melee rides the aura's own Banner entry.

activation_start_twice.why: PLAN_DOOR_ACTIVATION_START step 2 (lane doorStart, 22.11.): Reanimation is an activation-START effect. The table rolls it in `begin_activation` before the door captures the board, and the core, which takes the whole activation, rolls it again from that board. Measured (8 seeds per door, door on against off, dice dump): AI door 8/8 two pool rolls (the core rolls what is left of the pool), the core's volley fired more dice than the table's living shooters on 7/8 (+1/+2), `_land_positions` errored 7/8; human door 8/8 two pool rolls (the core re-rolls the FULL pool at Fire), the volley's dice count differs on 8/8, `_land_positions` errored 8/8; the core's roll never reaches the battle log. Shooter side only: a Reanimation unit shot at does not activate. The primitive covers Reanimation Aura's grant (the import copies Reanimation onto the unit and every joined hero). Bounding was measured equal (the core refuses a bonus move, the table resolves it) and stays taken; Spawn was not measured.
activation_start_twice.leaves_with: the door sending `start_done` after the table's start effects (PLAN_DOOR_ACTIVATION_START steps 3-5), then a 16-seed door on/off sweep of a Reanimation unit and an Aura-granted one (step 6)
